lines.quote: Designed and verified adaptive beamforming algorithms for the company's multi-element receive antenna products, including the 16-element uniform linear array used in the KW-200 platform.
The 16-element adaptive array I brought to prototype at Sumuvire Wireless in 2018 was the first fully digital beamforming product the company shipped.
Developed embedded DSP firmware in C on the TI TMS320C6748 processor for the KW-200 receiver chain, implementing real-time FFT windowing and sample-rate conversion at 40 MSPS.
I wrote the production data pipeline for our antenna array calibration system in Python.
The pipeline runs nightly in a Jenkins job now and nobody has to think about it, which is the point.

Performed RF power, gain, and noise-figure measurements on the X-band transmit/receive front end using an Agilent PNA-X vector network analyser, characterising feed-network losses across the 9.5–10.0 GHz band.
Compact synthetic aperture radar payload flight-tested on a Cessna 208B testbed for a Nordic defence agency.
Sustained airborne platform constraints -- thermal budgets in an unpressurised Cessna rack at altitude

requirements.name: Team-lead experience

lines.quote: As Head of DSP at Sumuvire from 2011 to 2013, I directed the beamforming development group through the KW-100 architecture definition, establishing the signal chain design and the embedded test framework that the team still uses.

requirements.note: The CV lists the candidate's title for the entire 2011–present period at Sumuvire Wireless as 'Signal Processing Engineer', an individual-contributor title, while the cover letter claims a formal 'Head of DSP' leadership title directing a development group for part of that same period (2011–2013), at the same employer. Both cannot straightforwardly be true as stated; not resolved here.

lines.quote: I hold Finnish citizenship and a valid security clearance.
Wrote all internal technical documentation in English and presented results at quarterly project reviews with the customer.
Based in Oulu, no relocation needed
Oulu is home and I have no plan to leave.
